purpose: Reduce the billing reservation by explicitly forcing 5-minute cache writes; model, reasoning effort, context and response limits are identical to v3. Only unstarted attempts may use this version.
reserve_calculation: 200000 input tokens at at most $5/M (5-minute cache write) plus 32000 output at $20/M = $1.64, rounded to $1.70. Uncached input $4/M and cache reads $0.20/M are lower.
per_session_budget: Explicitly recorded per attempt; budget/transport exits must not be interpreted as task difficulty.
